subcategory_text: The workforce is informed and trained on its roles and responsibilities.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AT-2 (Awareness Training), AT-3 (Role-Based Training)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.6.3 (Information security awareness, education and training)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.AT-01 (workforce awareness)
implementation_examples: Deliver privacy-awareness training to the workforce on their roles, responsibilities, and the organisational privacy values
Confirm completion of training at onboarding and at defined cadence (typically annually)
Tailor role-based training for those with elevated privacy responsibilities (engineers, marketers, HR, support)
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the workforce is informed and trained on privacy roles and responsibilities
Determine whether completion is verified at onboarding and on cadence
Determine whether role-based training is provided to elevated roles
Determine whether training materials reflect current policies and recent incidents
